title: Remove duplicated validation from the internal service

source.note: Written by the repository author for the v0.4.0 follow-up (tempting-correct repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Validation rules for subscriptions are duplicated in the HTTP parser and in the service, and they already drifted once (the service accepted quantity 2.5 while HTTP rejected it). Keep a single source of truth.
constraints: Team convention: parse and validate at the boundary, trust types inside the module.
No behaviour change for HTTP clients.
input.context: Node.js 20 service (ESM, JSDoc, checkJs strict). createSubscription() is not exported from the package entry point; its only caller is handlePostSubscription() in src/http.js, which runs parseSubscriptionRequest() first.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: 'missing input validation / defence in depth' advice for an internal function whose only caller already validates.
